title: The many moving parts of RAG

cues.en: We ended the last lecture on this picture of what RAG actually is, and it's about getting all our data into some kind of
cues.zh: 上一堂最後用這張圖說明 RAG，也就是把資料放進某種

cues.en: search index so we can search.
cues.zh: 搜尋索引，讓我們能搜尋。

cues.en: Let's turn this into a more abstract picture and show the flow of what's going on with the various components.
cues.zh: 現在換成比較抽象的流程圖，看看各個元件如何配合。

cues.en: So the moving parts are that we of course have some source data.
cues.zh: 首先，當然要有來源資料。

cues.en: We know of course that not all the data can be put in and also that not all the data we want to put in.
cues.zh: 我們知道，不是所有資料都能放進去，也不是所有資料都想放進去，

cues.en: So we need to take this data and we need to clean it and select it.
cues.zh: 所以需要先選取與清理資料。

cues.en: So that could be taking a PDF, getting the raw data out of it, getting the data out of images, or just taking the
cues.zh: 例如從 PDF 取出原始文字、從圖片擷取資訊，或是把

cues.en: data we have and preparing it so it is in the right format of the vector search.
cues.zh: 既有資料整理成適合向量搜尋的格式。

cues.en: After that, we need to embed the data, and the embedding of the data is actually to call a limb with the data in
cues.zh: 接著把資料轉成嵌入向量。這個步驟其實就是把整理好的資料交給模型，

cues.en: the structure we wanted and returning it back as what is called a vector.
cues.zh: 以我們需要的形式處理，再回傳所謂的向量。

cues.en: So vector is 1536 dimensions of that piece of data, so it can be searched across
cues.zh: 例如用 1,536 個維度表示這份資料，讓我們能跨越不同字詞，

cues.en: various things.
cues.zh: 搜尋相關內容。

cues.en: So if we search for cat, the word kitten can also be a similar type of data and so on.
cues.zh: 所以搜尋 cat，也可能找到語意相近的 kitten 等資料。

cues.en: We'll go more into embeddings in a separate lecture.
cues.zh: 嵌入向量會有另一堂專門介紹。

cues.en: And then we ingest it into a vector store.
cues.zh: 接著，把它匯入向量儲存區。

cues.en: There's various different vector stores to choose from, like for example, Azure AI Search, SQL Server that can be it, SQLite can be it,
cues.zh: 向量儲存區有很多選擇，例如 Azure AI Search、SQL Server、SQLite，

cues.en: you can even do in-memory, Cosmos DB, and there's some open source versions as well like Quadrant and Veviate, and other players like
cues.zh: 甚至記憶體內儲存、Cosmos DB，也有 Qdrant、Weaviate 等開放原始碼方案，以及

cues.en: Progress and Redis is in the game as well.
cues.zh: Postgres、Redis 等選項。

cues.en: So we're going to use SQL Server and SQLite and in-memory primarily, but all of them work the same because they're working with
cues.zh: 我們主要使用 SQL Server、SQLite 和記憶體內儲存，但操作方式相同，因為都搭配

cues.en: a NuGet package called MicrosoftExtensions.VectorData. Then our
cues.zh: Microsoft.Extensions.VectorData 這個 NuGet 套件。接著，

cues.en: user comes into play and asks that question.
cues.zh: 使用者出現，提出問題。

cues.en: And from that side, we again embed, and what we are embedding is actually the search query, because when we need to search for
cues.zh: 這一端同樣要做 Embedding，但轉成向量的是查詢內容。因為搜尋時，

cues.en: something, we need to similarity search against these vectors we put in on which of them are most like our question.
cues.zh: 必須拿問題的向量，和之前存入的向量做相似度比較。

cues.en: So we get our search query, turn it into a vector, and then we do a vector similarity search.
cues.zh: 因此，先把查詢轉成向量，再執行向量相似度搜尋。

cues.en: When we have done that search, we get some results back, we choose how many, and for each search result, we get some kind
cues.zh: 搜尋完成後，取得我們指定數量的結果，每一筆都會帶有某種

cues.en: of score, often it's one being it's an exact match, and zero being nothing in the manner.
cues.zh: 分數。常見情況是 1 代表完全相符，0 代表不相似。

cues.en: So like, for example, if we get a score of 0.7, that means it's 0 % the same, our search query compared to
cues.zh: 例如得到 0.7，就表示查詢與找到的內容，

cues.en: what it actually found.
cues.zh: 相似程度是 0.7。

cues.en: And once that happens, our AI, of course, can use those search results, get them into the context together with the question we have,
cues.zh: 然後 AI 就能把搜尋結果，和使用者的問題一起放進上下文，

cues.en: and answer the question.
cues.zh: 再回答問題。

cues.en: So this is all the parts that are, and we will have separate lectures on embeddings and ingestion and so on, and putting it
cues.zh: 這就是整個流程的各個部分。接下來會分別介紹嵌入向量、資料匯入等等，並在後續幾堂

cues.en: all together in the next few lectures.
cues.zh: 把它們全部串接起來。
